intro.title: A transparent instrument for Mongolia's mining-macro economy
intro.copy: M4 keeps historical data, accounting identities, institutional rules, and explicit user assumptions distinct.
intro.noForecast: This is not a forecast. It is a historical counterfactual against a selected quarter.

lab.title: M4 Scenario Lab
lab.copy: National historical accounting. It is not automatically connected to the ETT calculator.
lab.lambda: lambda_revenue — mining-export income change to revenue

limits.title: What M4 cannot determine from this scenario
limits.copy: There is not enough justified structure to calculate it. It is not zero.

status.title: Epistemic status
status.INSTITUTIONAL_RULE_desc: Calculated from a documented law or agreement.
status.USER_ASSUMPTION_desc: Depends on an assumption selected by the user.
status.CALIBRATED_ASSUMPTION_desc: Depends on a transparent calibrated parameter.
status.NOT_DETERMINED_desc: M4 does not yet have enough justified structure to compute this.

ett.title: ETT AMNAT calculator
ett.copy: Exported Erdenes Tavan Tolgoi coal only. It does not calculate GDP, total public revenue, CIT, or dividends.
ett.manual: User-supplied input: verify an official reference price for the same product. No nearby month or grade is substituted.

about.title: About M4
about.copy: M4 is not a fitted forecasting model; it is a transparent public alpha for historical accounting.
about.one: It separates observations, accounting identities, institutional rules, and assumptions.
about.two: There are no hidden fitted propagation coefficients.
about.three: When a link is not justified, the result is marked not determined.
